ey: abbr. 醫院；阿聯酋阿提哈德航空公司

n. An island.
n. See Egg.
eyas: n. an unfledged or nestling hawk
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">中古英語，為 neias、nyesse 的變體（由 a neias 的錯誤分讀所致），源自中古法語 niais（剛離巢的），源自（假定的）俗拉丁語 nidax（雛鳥），源自拉丁語 nidus（巢）——另見 nest</dd></dl>
eye:
n. 眼睛, 視力, 看
vt. 看, 注視

n. the organ of sight
n. good discernment (either visually or as if visually)

語感
中性，日常常用
詞根詞綴
古英語 eage，屬日耳曼語源，沒有拉丁或希臘詞根可拆
字族
eyelet (名詞)、eyeful (名詞)
常見搭配
keep an eye on；catch one's eye；in the eyes of；eye contact；see eye to eye
近義詞
gaze：動詞，持續而專注地看
glance：動詞，匆匆一瞥
watch：動詞，留意觀察
注意事項
the apple of one's eye 是「掌上明珠」；an eye for an eye 是「以眼還眼」；eye 當動詞時，現在分詞可拼作 eyeing 或 eying
eye-catching: a. 引人注目的, 引人矚目的
eye-opener: n. 使人驚奇的事物, 迷人的人, 迷人的事物, 使人大開眼界的事物
eyeball: n. the ball-shaped capsule containing the vertebrate eye

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>動詞義口語（字典標 informal）；名詞「眼球」中性</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>eyeball the suspects；eyeball to eyeball；up to your eyeballs in sth</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>stare at：長時間盯著看</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">eyeball to eyeball 指面對面對峙；up to your eyeballs in 指事情多到幾乎被淹沒</dd></dl>
eyebrow: n. the arch of hair above each eye

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>由 eye「眼睛」＋ brow「眉」組成</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>raise an eyebrow；raise eyebrows；be up to your eyebrows in sth</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">raise an eyebrow 表示驚訝或輕微不贊同，常用於比喻；raise eyebrows 指引起旁人這種反應</dd></dl>
eyed: a. having an eye or eyes or eyelike feature especially as specified; often used in combination
eyedrop:
n. a drop from an eye dropper
n. a method of irrigating the eye used by ophthalmologists
eyeful: n. 滿眼, 滿眶, 眼之容量

n. a strikingly beautiful woman
n. a full view; a good look
eyeglass: n lens for correcting defective vision in one eye; held in place by facial muscles
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>「單片眼鏡」義偏老式；「眼鏡」義主要用於美式英語</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>a pair of eyeglasses</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">指一般眼鏡時多用複數 eyeglasses</dd></dl>
eyehole:
n a hole (in a door or an oven etc) through which you can peep
n a small hole (usually round and finished around the edges) in cloth or leather for the passage of a cord or hook or bar
eyelash: n. any of the short curved hairs that grow from the edges of the eyelids

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，日常用語</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>false eyelashes；not bat an eyelash</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">not bat an eyelash 表示「面不改色」，美式較常見；英式多說 not bat an eyelid</dd></dl>
eyeless:
a. lacking eyes or eyelike features
s. lacking sight
eyelet:
n. 小孔, 孔眼, 針眼, 金屬圈
[化] 孔眼; 窺視孔
n. a small hole (usually round and finished around the edges) in cloth or leather for the passage of a cord or hook or bar
eyelid:
n. 眼皮, 眼瞼
[醫] 瞼
n. either of two folds of skin that can be moved to cover or open the eye
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，日常用語</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>the upper／lower eyelid；not bat an eyelid</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">not bat an eyelid 是慣用語，表示「面不改色」</dd></dl>
eyeliner: n. makeup applied to emphasize the shape of the eyes
eyepatch: n. a protective cloth covering for an injured eye
eyepiece: n. combination of lenses at the viewing end of optical instruments
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，光學器材用語</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>複合字：eye「眼睛」＋ piece「部件」，字面是「靠眼睛使用的部件」</dd></dl>
eyeshade: n. 遮光眼罩, 眼瞼膏
n a brim that projects to the front to shade the eyes
eyeshadow: n. makeup consisting of a cosmetic substance used to darken the eyes
eyeshot: n the range of the eye
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；第 2 義為古語</dd></dl>
eyesight: n. normal use of the faculty of vision

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，日常與正式都用</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>複合字：eye「眼睛」＋ sight「視覺」</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>failing eyesight；good／bad／poor eyesight；lose one's eyesight</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>vision：同指視力，另可指遠見或視野</dd></dl>
eyesore: n. something very ugly and offensive
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，口氣直接</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>複合字：eye「眼睛」＋ sore「痛處」，字面是「刺痛眼睛的東西」</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>a real eyesore</dd></dl>
eyestalk:
n. One of the movable peduncles which, in the decapod
Crustacea, bear the eyes at the tip.
eyestrain:
n. 眼睛疲勞
[醫] 眼疲勞
n. a tiredness of the eyes caused by prolonged close work by a person with an uncorrected vision problem
eyewash:
n. 洗眼水, 無稽之談, 騙局
[醫] 洗眼藥水(洗眼劑)
n lotion consisting of a solution used as a cleanser for the eyes
eyewear: <dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>偏正式，泛指眼鏡類商品</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>由 eye「眼睛」＋ wear「穿戴」組成</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>protective eyewear；fashionable eyewear</dd></dl>
eyewink: <dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；第 2 義為已廢用</dd></dl>
eyewitness: n. 目擊者, 見證人

n. a spectator who can describe what happened
v. be present at an event and see it with one's own eyes

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，新聞與司法場合常見</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>複合字：eye「眼睛」＋ witness「證人」</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>an eyewitness account；an eyewitness to the shooting</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>witness：較一般的說法，也可指法庭上的證人，不一定親眼目睹</dd></dl>
eyre:
n. 巡迴, 巡迴法院
[法] 巡迴, 巡回法庭
n. a shallow salt lake in south central Australia about 35 feet below sea level; the largest lake in the country and the lowest point on the continent
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">中古英語 eire，源自盎格魯-法語，再源自古法語 erre（行程、旅程、巡行），源自 errer（旅行）— 另見 err</dd></dl>
eyrie: n. (=aerie)(鷹等的)巢, 高山住屋(或城堡)

n the lofty nest of a bird of prey (such as a hawk or eagle)
n any habitation at a high altitude
eyrir: n. 奧拉(冰島的一種硬幣)
n 100 aurar equal 1 krona in Iceland
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">冰島語，源自古諾爾斯語（通常為銀的）盎司（複數指錢幣），可能源自拉丁語 aureus（金幣）— 另見 aureus</dd></dl>
